title: G310RR Supersport
description: The BMW Motorrad G310RR Supersport is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, positioned in the Middleweight Sportbike segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
